diff --git a/woodwork/tests/test_repair_ordinal_order_validation.py b/woodwork/tests/test_repair_ordinal_order_validation.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/woodwork/tests/test_repair_ordinal_order_validation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+import pandas as pd
+import pytest
+
+from woodwork.column_schema import ColumnSchema
+from woodwork.logical_types import Ordinal
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    'order, error',
+    [
+        (['a', 'a'], ValueError),
+        (('a', 'a'), ValueError),
+        ('a', TypeError),
+        ({'a'}, TypeError),
+        ({'a': 0}, TypeError),
+    ],
+    ids=['duplicate-list', 'duplicate-tuple', 'string', 'set', 'mapping'],
+)
+def test_invalid_ordinal_orders_are_rejected_when_validating_data(order, error):
+    schema = ColumnSchema(logical_type=Ordinal(order=order))
+    values = pd.Series(['a'])
+    with pytest.raises(error):
+        schema.logical_type._validate_data(values)

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /testbed || exit 1
python -m pytest woodwork/tests/test_repair_ordinal_order_validation.py -q
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
